description: P35 (plan M6-M9 §5.4, §5.5, §5.7): the Needle, a slot canyon 5 m wide through the ridge east of Hollowmere, leads to the Hidden Grove (the quest starts when the giant finds the Needle or comes within 200 m of the grove). A giant of stages 3-4 walks the slot; a bigger one has outgrown it and heaves the rockfall on the grove's north ridge instead (stage 5). The grove holds the Old Root stone (its cache: 1 titan iron), lore and a cairn; reaching it: 100 XP. Never missable: one key or the other at every stage from 3.

stages.objective: Find the way into the Hidden Grove
stages.waiting_text: The Needle's slot fits a giant of stages 3-4; a bigger one heaves the rockfall on the grove's north ridge (stage 5).
